narrative.overview: The light paper ground, serif headings and restrained blue and sage diagrams make dense mathematics readable. A diagram shows an actual state, coordinate, projection or dependence. Controls let the reader perform the named operation.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: A quantity retains its label and colour as it moves between the two sides of an explanatory diagram.

dos: Do show the actual input and resulting state together.
Do preserve labels, units, source conditions and numerical grouping.
Do inspect 390px, 768px and desktop layouts using real content.
Do keep source links close to their corresponding operation.
donts: Don't substitute a repeated number for the map that relates two objects.
Don't let diagram styling affect mathematical typesetting.
Don't label an inventory or deterministic precision as experimental confirmation.
Don't duplicate the historical presentation inside the current introductory route.
